title: JSON Schema for CoreEx File code-generation (https://github.com/avanade/coreex).

version.title: Definition revision.
version.description: Not a package/source version, layout selector, or business deduplication key.

runtimeProjectPath.title: Runtime project directory.
runtimeProjectPath.description: Relative to the CodeGen output/project directory, or absolute. No Functions project is required.

runtimePath.title: Runtime subfolder.
runtimePath.description: Defaults to Files/<Name>; must remain inside runtimeProjectPath.

runtimeNamespace.title: Generated namespace.
runtimeNamespace.description: Defaults to project directory name plus runtimePath segments. Explicit override avoids assumptions about MSBuild RootNamespace.

format.title: Input format.
format.description: Defaults to Csv. JSON document and XML readers are not yet supported.

csv.title: CSV parser, routing, and assembly settings.

json.title: Shared JSON mapping settings.
json.description: JSONL only in this release; kind/unitPath/document selection are not supported.

mode.title: Default processing mode.
mode.description: Defaults to ValidateOnly. Valid-unit reporting is an optional processor hook in every mode; ValidateAndExecute validates and executes each unit in one pass.

quote.title: Quote.
quote.description: One character; defaults to double quote.

comment.title: Comment marker.
comment.description: One character at record start; omitted by default.

encoding.title: Explicit encoding.
encoding.description: Defaults to Utf8. Strict runtime decoding; no BOM-based encoding switching.

headerPolicy.title: Named header policy.
headerPolicy.description: Flat named-column mappings only; defaults to AllowAdditionalColumns. Exact rejects extra header columns and rows whose field count differs from the header.

discriminatorIndex.title: Zero-based discriminator index.
discriminatorIndex.description: Selects unordered routing without structure; required with structure; omitted for flat input.

structure.title: Business-root hierarchy.
structure.description: Omit for unordered routed records (with discriminatorIndex) or one flat record (without discriminatorIndex).

unknownMemberPolicy.title: Unknown member policy.
unknownMemberPolicy.description: Defaults to Reject; applies recursively to units and declared metadata.

maxDepth.title: Positive nesting limit.
maxDepth.description: Defaults to 64; includes ignored objects and arrays.

discriminator.title: Direct string discriminator.
discriminator.description: Omit for ordinary object units. Required for metadata routing; no implicit type-member convention.

blankLinePolicy.title: Blank-line policy.
blankLinePolicy.description: Defaults to Reject. Skip excludes blank lines from records/units but not bytes/physical lines.

record.title: Business root record.
record.description: Inferred only when exactly one non-metadata, non-child record is eligible.

required.title: Required metadata.
required.description: Defaults to false; duplicate occurrences are always errors.

position.title: Metadata position.
position.description: Defaults to Any; blank/comment records and the column-name header do not count.

position.title: Metadata position.
position.description: Defaults to Any; malformed/unroutable non-skipped lines participate.

match.title: Exact discriminator.
match.description: Required for routed files; forbidden for flat files.

cardinality.title: File cardinality.
cardinality.description: Unordered routed files only; defaults to Many. Counts include recognized invalid records. Hierarchical cardinality belongs on structure nodes.

position.title: File position.
position.description: Unordered routed files only; defaults to Any. First/Last require One or Optional cardinality.

name.title: Source field name.
name.description: Exact JSON direct member or CSV column name; logical label for positional CSV fields.

property.title: Generated C# property override.
property.description: Defaults to DbEx-style PascalCase derivation from name.

type.title: Logical type.
type.description: Defaults to String only without record/collection. Native JSON token types are required; all wire properties are nullable.

record.title: Nested object record.
record.description: JSONL only; mutually exclusive with type/collection. Required rejects missing/null; present objects always validate.

collection.title: Nested collection occurrence.
collection.description: JSONL only; mutually exclusive with type/record. Null elements are not supported.

format.title: Exact invariant date format.
format.description: Optional for CSV and JSON dates; when omitted, uses standard invariant parsing. DateTimeOffset always requires an explicit Z or numeric offset; JSON DateTime rejects offsets. Also applies to scalar collection elements and date bounds/options.

required.title: Reject null.
required.description: Defaults to false. Uses NotNull, not Mandatory, for value types.

maxLength.title: Maximum string length.
maxLength.description: Nonnegative; String properties only. Zero permits only empty strings or null.

mandatory.title: Reject null and default values.
mandatory.description: Defaults to false. Unlike required, rejects zero and false.

regex.title: Regular expression.
regex.description: String only; generated cached regex has a one-second timeout.

min.title: Inclusive minimum.
min.description: String, numeric or date value; dates use the property format. String ordering is culture-sensitive.

max.title: Inclusive maximum.
max.description: String, numeric or date value; dates use the property format.

precision.title: Decimal precision.
precision.description: Decimal only; from 1 through 29. No rounding.

scale.title: Decimal scale.
scale.description: Decimal only; from 0 through 28, not greater than precision.

options.title: Allowed values.
options.description: Nonempty typed scalars; dates use the property format. Values are not canonicalized.

referenceData.title: Reference-data code validation.
referenceData.description: Uses the existing CoreEx ReferenceData rule without converting the code to an object. The caller must initialize the ambient reference-data orchestrator and load this collection before processing.

record.title: Element record.
record.description: Exactly one of record/type is required.

type.title: Scalar element type.
type.description: Exactly one of record/type is required. Null elements are rejected.

cardinality.title: Per-parent cardinality.
cardinality.description: Defaults to Many; missing/null counts as zero.

maxItems.title: Optional maximum elements.
maxItems.description: No maximum by default. An explicit positive count is a business constraint checked before element mapping.

index.title: Zero-based CSV index.
index.description: Required for routed files; flat files may use a named source field instead.

type.title: Reference-data CLR type.
type.description: An existing IReferenceData type, for example Contoso.Contracts.ReferenceData.Country. The wire property remains string?.

allowInactive.title: Allow inactive codes.
allowInactive.description: Defaults to false. Unknown codes always fail validation.
